title: How to 【make sprites shake when damaged】？

posts.author: zslucky
posts.body:
Hey guys it me again.Thanks to those who have come to the forum over the last few days willing to answer my questions！
I am improving my battle system these days.And I noticed that some players dissatisfied with the feedback when the enemy is being attacked.
I also noticed that some RPG battle like persona3 Reload may
shake the sprite when they are damaged(HP)
.
How can I achieve this in RMMZ?
Or any advice on improving combat strikes and acquisitions?
Thanks!

posts.author: ISC
posts.body:
If you're skilled in graphic editing, you could work directly on the battlers' sheet. As you'll see, the sheet is divided into sections and, with a lot of patience, you could create the effect you want by modifying the battler's graphics.
RPG Maker MV/MZ Templates and Guideline
For Sideview Battlers:       Windowskin        Iconset       Damage Popup Sheet        Balloon    States            Weapon     Facesets    Characterset    @Andar     A4 Template - Unnumbered           A4 Template - My Numbering           A4 Template - Numbered Based on...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
